lawyer:
Mr. SR Pal, Senior Advocate instructed by Mr. Md. Ozair Farooq, Advocate-on-Record ------- For the Petitioners.

parties:
MA Wahab and another ------- Petitioners.
Vs.
Abul Kalam and another ------- Respondents.
full_judgment: Mustafa Kamal, J.: The trial Court having dismissed the defendants application under Order IX, Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure for setting aside the ex parte decree passed against them on 28-7-85, they preferred an appeal to the High Court Division which allowed the same on condition of payment of Tk. 3,000/= to the plaintiff who now seeks leave to appeal from the said judgment.
